## Pre-merge checklist

- [ ] [`CHANGELOG.md`](../CHANGELOG.md) updated and committed
- [ ] Version references updated in any version-bearing files (none currently — the project is unversioned in source)

## Post-merge actions
After this MR merges to `main`:

```bash
git checkout main && git pull
git tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "Release vX.Y.Z"
git push origin vX.Y.Z
# back-merge to develop
git checkout develop && git merge --no-ff main && git push
```

The tag push triggers the `release` stage of `.gitlab-ci.yml` which:
1. Generates the final CHANGELOG section
2. Creates a GitLab Release with notes derived from conventional commits
